title: Redacted FBI files on Silas Newton and GeBauer

tellings.quote:
And then you have these FBI files
on Silus Newton and Gabau going way back
to the uh I think the 30s or something
and they're they're totally redacted.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions files kept by the FBI, the US federal police, on two men named Silas Newton and Leo GeBauer. He says the files go back to around the 1930s and are almost completely redacted, meaning blacked out, which he takes as a sign the government had something to hide about them.
